import os,re,json

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop()
                    if (y,x) in seen or not(0<=y<H) or not(0<=x<W) or g[y][x]==bg: continue
                    seen.add((y,x)); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy in(-1,0,1):
                        for dx in(-1,0,1): st.append((y+dy,x+dx))
                out.append(comp)
    return out

import numpy as np, os, re
from collections import Counter, deque

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G)[:2])

def comps_multi(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and not seen[r][c]:
                st=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; cells=[]
                while st:
                    p,q=st.pop(); cells.append((p,q,g[p][q]))
                    for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        pr,pq=p+di,q+dj
                        if 0<=pr<H and 0<=pq<W and g[pr][pq]!=bg and not seen[pr][pq]:
                            seen[pr][pq]=True; st.append((pr,pq))
                out.append(cells)
    return out

def variants(rel):
    # rel: list of (dr,dc,val). Return 8 dihedral versions normalized to origin (min 0,0).
    res=[]
    cur=rel
    for _ in range(4):
        n=(min(r for r,_,_ in cur), min(c for _,c,_ in cur))
        res.append(tuple(sorted((r-n[0],c-n[1],v) for r,c,v in cur)))
        res.append(tuple(sorted((c,-r,v) for r,c,v in cur)))
        cur=[(c,-r,v) for r,c,v in cur]
    out=[]
    seen=set()
    for t in res:
        if t not in seen: seen.add(t); out.append(t)
    return out

def stamp_predict(inp):
    ai=np.array(inp)
    H,W=ai.shape
    bg=int(np.bincount(ai.flatten()).argmax())
    comps=comps_multi(ai.tolist(),bg)
    tpl_objs=[c for c in comps if len(c)>1 and len(set(x[2] for x in c))>=2]
    singles=[(p,q,v) for c in comps if len(c)==1 for p,q,v in c]
    out=[row[:] for row in ai.tolist()]
    for obj in tpl_objs:
        cnt=Counter(v for _,_,v in obj)
        anch=None; ac=None
        # anchor = cell whose color count==1 within object; if none, skip (noise)
        odds=[o for o in obj if cnt[o[2]]==1]
        if not odds: continue
        anch=odds[0]; ac=anch[2]
        rel=[(p-anch[0],q-anch[1],v) for p,q,v in obj]
        for vart in variants(rel):
            dr0,dc0=vart[0][0],vart[0][1]
            for (sr,sc,col) in singles:
                if col!=ac: continue
                tr,tc=sr-dr0,sc-dc0
                ok=True
                for dr,dc,v in vart:
                    rr,cc=tr+dr,tc+dc
                    if not(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W): ok=False;break
                    if out[rr][cc]==bg: out[rr][cc]=v
                    elif out[rr][cc]!=v: ok=False;break
                if ok: break
    return out

# test identity-plus-variants approach on demos: which variant explains each instance? First check coverage fraction of ADDS explained by ANY variant placement (with priority to avoid collisions), ignoring exact orientation correctness.
ok=0; tot=0
for n in range(1,9):
    a=G['Demo pair %d input'%n]; b=np.array(G['Demo pair %d output'%n])
    ai=np.array(a)
    ch=[(r,c,int(bi[r][c])) for r in range(ai.shape[0]) for c in range(ai.shape[1])] if False else None
    ch=[(r,c,int(bi[r][c])) for r in range(ai.shape[0]) for c in range(ai.shape[1])] if False else [(r,c,int(bi[r][c])) for r in range(ai.shape[0]) for c in range(ai.shape[1])]

    exp={(r,c) for r in range(ai.shape[0]) for c in range(ai.shape[1]) if ai[r][c]!=bi[r][c]}

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter

def comps_multi(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and not seen[r][c]:
                st=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; cells=[]
                while st:
                    p,q=st.pop(); cells.append((p,q,g[p][q]))
                    for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        pr,pq=p+di,q+dj
                        if 0<=pr<H and 0<=pq<W and g[pr][pq]!=bg and not seen[pr][pq]:
                            seen[pr][pq]=True; st.append((pr,pq))
                out.append(cells)
    return out

def diheds(rel):
    res=[]; cur=list(rel)
    for _ in range(4):
        mr=min(r for r,_,_ in cur); mc=min(c for _,c,_ in cur)
        res.append(tuple(sorted((r-mr,c-mc,v) for r,c,v in cur)))
        res.append(tuple(sorted((-c,r,v,v) if False else (-c,r,v) for r,c,v in cur)))
        cur=[(-c,r,v) for r,c,v in cur]
    outs=[]
    for tt in res:
        if tt not in outs: outs.append(tt)
    return outs

# Hypothesis C: for a seed of color col, choose among ALL valid placements
# (any template containing col as one of its colors, any dihedral variant,
# anchor-aligned to the seed cell) the one whose NON-anchor footprint
# is smallest (fewest cells) — i.e., the tightest-fitting template.
# Among ties pick lexicographically smallest (tmpl idx, variant idx).
# Then verify on all 8 demos.

def f(inp):
    a=[list(r) for r in inp]; H,W=len(a),len(a[0])
    cnt=Counter(sum(a,[])); bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    cs=comps_multi(a,bg)
    singles=[tuple(c[0]) for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    tmpls=[[(p-min(p for p,_,_ in c), q-min(q for _,q,_ in c), v) for p,q,v in c] for c in cs if len(c)>1]
    out=[row[:] for row in a]
    for sr,sc,col in singles:
        cands=[]
        for ti,tshape in enumerate(tmpls):
            if col not in {v for _,_,v in tshape}: continue
            # skip degenerate single-color templates? keep them; they yield paint sizes >=0
            for vi,var in enumerate(diheds([(r,c,v) for r,c,v in tshape])):
                for idx,(ar,ac,vv) in enumerate(var):
                    if vv!=col: continue
                    dr0=sr-ar; dc0=sc-ac
                    good=True
                    for r,c,vv2 in var:
                        rr,cc=dr0+r,dc0+c
                        if not(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W): good=False;break
                        if a[rr][cc]!=bg and a[rr][cc]!=vv2: good=False;break
                    if good:
                        pa=[(dr0+r,dc0+c,vv2) for r,c,vv2 in var if (dr0+r,dc0+c)!=(sr,sc)]
                        cands.append((len(pa),ti,vi,idx,pa))
        if not cands: continue
        cands.sort()
        for rr,cc,v in cands[0][4]: out[rr][cc]=v
    return out

for n in range(1,9):

import numpy as np
def dihedral_cells(cells):
    # cells: list of (dr,dc,color). Return 8 variant lists.
    def variant(f):
        return [(f(r,c),col) for r,c,col in cells]
    Vs=[lambda r,c:(r,c),lambda r,c:(r,-c),lambda r,c:(-r,c),lambda r,c:(-r,-c),
        lambda r,c:(c,r),lambda r,c:(c,-r),lambda r,c:(-c,r),lambda r,c:(-c,-r)]
    outs=[]
    for f in Vs:
        v=variant(f)
        mr=min(r for r,c,_ in v); mc=min(c for r,c,_ in v)
        outs.append(sorted((r-mr,c-mc,col) for r,c,col in v))
    # dedupe
    res=[]
    for o in outs:
        if o not in res: res.append(o)
    return res
def find_placement(a,b,tmpl,seedcolor):
    H,W=a.shape
    seeds=[(i,j,int(a[i,j])) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if a[i,j]==seedcolor]
    res=[]
    for var in dihedral_cells(tmpl):
        # anchor = cell whose color==seedcolor (must exist)
        anchors=[(r,c) for r,c,col in var if col==seedcolor]
        for ar,ac in anchors:
            for si,sj,_ in seeds:
                dr_,dc_=si-ar,sj-ac
                fp=[(r+dr_,c+dc_,col) for r,c,col in var]
                ok=True; painted=set()
                for r,c,col in fp:
                    if not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W): ok=False;break
                    cur=int(a[r,c])
                    if cur!=bgc(a) and cur!=col: ok=False;break
                    if cur==bgc(a): painted.add((r,c))
                if not ok: continue
                if painted==set((i,j) for i,j,o,nz in diff(a,b)):
                    res.append((var,(ar,ac),dr_,dc_,sorted(painted)))
    return res
def bgc(a): return Counter(a.flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
def diff(a,b): return [(i,j,int(a[i,j]),int(b[i,j])) for i in range(a.shape[0]) for j in range(a.shape[1]) if a[i,j]!=b[i,j]]
for n in [3,6]:
    a=np.array(G['Demo pair %d input'%n]); b=np.array(G['Demo pair %d output'%n])
    adds=diff(a,b)
    print('=== demo',n)
    objs=analyze(n)
    for tag,cells,_ in analyze(n)[2][:]: pass
    # rebuild: analyze returns a,b,objs
    _,_,objs=analyze(n)
    tmpl_objs=[o for o in objs if len(o)>1]
    seeds=[o for o in objs if len(o)==1]
    for sc,(si,sj) in [(int(a[s[0]]),s[1]) for s in seeds]:
        for t in tmpl_objs:
            res=find_placement(a,b,t,sc)
            if res: print(f'seed {sc}@({si},{sj}) tmpl{len(t)}:placements={len(res)} first={res[0][:3] if res else None}')

    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape; bgc_=Counter(g.flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool); objs=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):

            q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i,j]=True; cells=[(i,j)]
            while q:

def dihed_variants(rels):
    # rels list of ((r,c),color) normalized tuples
    Vs=[lambda p:p, lambda p:(p[0],-p[1]), lambda p:(-p[0],p[1]), lambda p:(-p[0],-p[1]),
        lambda p:(p[1],p[0]), lambda p:(p[1],-p[0]), lambda p:(-p[1],p[0]), lambda p:(-p[1],-p[0])]
    res=set()

        v=[(f(p),col) for p,col in rels]
        mr=min(p[0] for p,_ in v); mc=min(c for _,c in v)

import numpy as np, json, os, re
from collections import Counter, deque, defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape; bgc_=Counter(g.flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool); objs=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if seen[i,j] or g[i,j]==bgc_: continue
            q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i,j]=True; cells=[(i,j)]
            while q:
                x,y=q.popleft()
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    u,v=x+dx,y+dy
                    if 0<=u<H and 0<=v<W and not seen[u,v] and g[u,v]!=bgc_:
                        seen[u,v]=True; q.append((u,v)); cells.append((u,v))
            objs.append(cells)
    return objs,bgc_
def dihed_variants(rels):
    Vs=[lambda p:p, lambda p:(p[0],-p[1]), lambda p:(-p[0],p[1]), lambda p:(-p[0],-p[1]),
        lambda p:(p[1],p[0]), lambda p:(p[1],-p[0]), lambda p:(-p[1],p[0]), lambda p:(-p[1],-p[0])]
    res=set()
    for f in Vs:
        v=[(f(p),col) for p,col in rels]
        mr=min(p[0] for p,_ in v); mc=min(c for _,c in v)
        res.add(tuple(sorted(((r-mr,c-mc),col) for (r,c),col in v)))
    return res
# demo1 analysis: seed (0,3) is '6' - color 6. Which template has color 6? none! templates colors: {2,1,0,3,7,8,9}.
# So the adds near that seed... what are they? none near (0,3)? earlier near-add list for that seed was []. 
# Check: does each seed have at least one nearby add? Let's map adds to nearest seed by chebyshev dist.
a=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 input']); b=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 output'])
seeds=[(o[0][0],o[0][1],int(a[o[0][0],o[0][1]])) for o in comps(a)[0] if len(o)==1]
adds=[(i,j,int(b[i,j])) for i in range(a.shape[0]) for j in range(a.shape[1]) if a[i,j]!=b[i,j]]
print('seeds:',seeds)
for ai,aj,acol in adds:
    best=min(seeds,key=lambda s: max(abs(s[0]-ai),abs(s[1]-aj)))
    print((ai,aj,acol),'nearest seed',best, 'dist',max(abs(best[0]-ai),abs(best[1]-aj)))

from collections import Counter,deque
import numpy as np
def comps(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape; bgc_=Counter(g.flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool); objs=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if seen[i,j] or g[i,j]==bgc_: continue
            q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i,j]=True; cells=[(i,j)]
            while q:
                x,y=q.popleft()
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    u,v=x+dx,y+dy
                    if 0<=u<H and 0<=v<W and not seen[u,v] and g[u,v]!=bgc_:
                        seen[u,v]=True; q.append((u,v)); cells.append((u,v))
            objs.append(cells)
    return objs,bgc_
def variants(cells):
    F=[lambda p:p, lambda p:(p[0],-p[1]), lambda p:(-p[0],p[1]), lambda p:(-p[0],-p[1]),
       lambda p:(p[1],p[0]), lambda p:(p[1],-p[0]), lambda p:(-p[1],p[0]), lambda p:(-p[1],-p[0])]
    res=set()
    for f in F:
        v=[(f(p),col) for p,col in cells]
        mr=min(p[0] for p,_ in v); mc=min(c for _,c in v)
        res.add(tuple(sorted(((r-mr,c-mc),col) for (r,c),col in v)))
    return res
# FIX: per SEED, placement must only ADD bg cells (subset of adds allowed), and must cover SOME adds.
# Choose per-seed minimal placements that together cover ALL adds. First list per-seed candidate add-subs.
for n in [1,2,3]:
    a=np.array(G['Demo pair %d input'%n]); b=np.array(G['Demo pair %d output'%n])
    H,W=a.shape; objs,bg=comps(a)
    tmpls=[sorted([((r-min(p[0] for p in o),c-min(p[1] for p in o)),int(a[p])) for p in o]) for o in objs if len(o)>1]
    seeds=[(o[0][0],o[0][1],int(a[o[0][0],o[0][1]])) for o in objs if len(o)==1]
    adds=frozenset((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if a[i,j]!=b[i,j])
    print('demo',n,'nadds',len(adds),'seeds',len(seeds),'tmpls',len(tmpls))
    for si,sj,sc in seeds:
        cands=[]
        for ti,tm in enumerate(tmpls):
            if sc not in set(c for _,c in tm): continue
            for var in variants(tm):
                for (vr,vc),vcol in var:
                    dr_,dc_=si-vr,sj-vc
                    placed=[(rr+dr_,cc+dc_) for (rr,cc),col in var]
                    if any(not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W) for r,c in placed): continue
                    if not all(a[r,c]==bg for r,c in placed): continue
                    cov={(r,c) for r,c in placed}
                    if not (cov & adds): continue
                    cands.append((ti,var,(dr_,dc_),frozenset(cov)))
        print(' seed',(si,sj,sc),'cands',len(cands),'addsub sizes',{len(c[3]) for c in cands})
